purpose: A spinning glyph that says something is happening when the wait has no known length. It is the Loading glyph of Button, Switch, Textarea, InputTag and DatePicker, for action feedback.

notFor.case: Loading content in a page or list (prefer a skeleton layout).
A button that is busy: use the button's own loading state.

Default.visual: The loader glyph spinning in Content/secondary.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable; no keyboard interaction of its own.
a11y.reducedMotion: The spin stops under prefers-reduced-motion (motion-reduce:animate-none); the glyph stays.

openQuestions: Spinner is code-only, with no Figma set (finding DOC-001 Spinner). Should it get one?
The description says it takes the ink of the text around it, but the binding is Content/secondary. Which is right?
